market_interpretation.price_context: Nov 17 aggregate observations cluster around $0.9566-$0.9579, while a separate perp vendor snapshot is around $0.9607-$0.9599. These are not synchronized spot prices.
market_interpretation.leverage: Liqwall and TradRadar show falling OI; Swiftedge shows rising OI. Do not average: venue coverage, cutoff and metric definitions differ.
market_interpretation.depth: Basis shows a slightly bid-heavy Binance perpetual book at 08:11 UTC; this is not spot depth or proof of durable demand. Swiftedge walls are vendor-derived and can be cancelled.
market_interpretation.etf_flows: CryptoKeyhole's Nov 16 figure is explicitly partial; XRP Insights includes six spot funds plus BITW; Alpha and Maketo use five-fund cohorts and report zero for Nov 16. The values are not directly comparable.
counter_hypotheses: OI contraction can be position closure or liquidation, not necessarily new short initiation.
A one-venue bid-heavy perpetual book can be transient and can be pulled.
ETF net flow can be positive in a broader fund set while a partial subset reports outflows.
Stablecoin adoption on XRPL increases network utility but does not translate mechanically into proportional XRP purchases.
SBI's Circle/Arc/USDC activity is not evidence of XRP demand.

law_and_entities.relationship_conclusion: The three SBIC companies are the three distinct statutory investment-development corporations under Act No. 101 of 1963. Their official profiles identify them as sister companies to one another. SBI Holdings is a separate holding company. No SBI Holdings ownership or group affiliation for the three SBIC companies was identified in the reviewed primary records; this is a scoped negative finding, not proof that no indirect commercial contact has ever existed.
law_and_entities.xrp_relationship: No XRP, Ripple, Circle, Coinbase or SBI Holdings relationship was identified for SBIC East, Central or West.
